summary.description: One line on what this Attempt changed, written like a commit subject.

handoff.description: What the next agent on this Ticket needs to know: what is done, what is left, and where you got stuck.

answers.description: One answer for each comment in the Brief, which a `comment` Operation posts on the Ticket as a reply.

comment.description: The `id` of the comment this answers.

text.description: What you did about it, or why you did nothing.
